label: scam
title: Medicare -- new card, pay to activate

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Medicare. Your benefits will lapse unless we issue a new card today.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: I didn't know it was expiring.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There's a $150 activation fee -- a prepaid card works. We must process it in the next few minutes.
